name: waygraph-example-saucedemo
description: Full Sauce Demo (saucedemo.com) example - Effect / MemNav / waygraph auto.

scripts.demo: waygraph demo --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"},\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}"
scripts.demo:step: waygraph demo --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow" --title "Shop demo" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"},\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}"
scripts.demo:auto-next: waygraph demo --blocks "loginFlow then shopFlow" --auto-next --title "Product then cart" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"},\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}"
scripts.prove: npm run prove:login-branch && npm run prove:graph && npm run prove:add-to-cart-menu && npm test
scripts.demo:device: waygraph demo --blocks deviceShowcaseFlow --auto-next --title "Device showcase" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"},\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}"
scripts.demo:device:video: waygraph demo --blocks deviceShowcaseFlow --auto-play-video --title "Device showcase" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"},\"saucedemo.selectedItem\":{\"id\":\"sauce-labs-backpack\",\"name\":\"Sauce Labs Backpack\"}}" --video ./.tmp/device-showcase
scripts.run:bulk: waygraph run --blocks "loginFlow then add-all-to-cart then remove-all-from-cart" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}"
scripts.chain:bulk: waygraph run --blocks "loginFlow then add-all-to-cart then remove-all-from-cart" --data "{\"saucedemo.credentials\":{\"username\":\"standard_user\",\"password\":\"secret_sauce\"}}" --non-headless
